R001.original_name: 主机冷却水系统应具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。系统应能在连续运行、热带海区高温环境和主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力。
R001.original_text: 主机冷却水系统应具备较高运行可靠性，不能因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。系统应能在连续运行、热带海区高温环境和主机负荷变化时保持稳定冷却能力。
R001.english_text: The main engine cooling water system shall provide high operational reliability. Inadequate cooling capacity, interruption of cooling water circulation or loss of temperature control shall not impair the safe operation of the propulsion plant. The system shall maintain stable cooling capacity during continuous operation, in high-temperature tropical waters and during changes in main engine load.
R001.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R001-01.original_text: 主机冷却水系统应配置不少于两台冷却水泵，其中至少一台为独立电力驱动，各泵应具有在主机额定功率工况下单独满足冷却水流量需求的能力；系统应设置高温报警和自动保护，确保不因冷却能力不足、冷却水循环中断或温度失控影响推进装置安全运行。
ER-R001-01.english_text: The main engine cooling water system shall be equipped with at least two cooling water pumps, at least one of which shall be independently electrically driven. Each pump shall be capable of independently meeting the cooling water flow requirement at the rated power of the main engine. The system shall provide high-temperature alarms and automatic protection to prevent inadequate cooling capacity, interruption of cooling water circulation or loss of temperature control from impairing the safe operation of the propulsion plant.
ER-R001-01.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R001-02.original_name: 热带海区高温环境适应性
ER-R001-02.original_text: 主机冷却水系统应能在热带海区高温环境下保持稳定冷却能力，系统设计应基于最高海水温度按项目设计基准（Design Basis）确认，冷却水温度应保持在主机厂家规定的限值内。
ER-R001-02.english_text: The main engine cooling water system shall maintain stable cooling capacity in high-temperature tropical waters. The maximum seawater temperature used for system design shall be confirmed against the project Design Basis, and the cooling water temperature shall remain within the limits specified by the main engine manufacturer.
ER-R001-02.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R001-03.original_name: 负荷变化工况温度控制
ER-R001-03.original_text: 主机冷却水系统应配置温度自动调节装置，能在主机负荷变化时自动调节冷却水温度，使其保持在主机厂家规定的限值内；系统应设置高温报警和自动保护，当冷却水温度超过高报警设定值时发出报警。
ER-R001-03.english_text: The main engine cooling water system shall be equipped with automatic temperature regulation that adjusts the cooling water temperature as the main engine load changes and maintains it within the limits specified by the main engine manufacturer. The system shall provide high-temperature alarms and automatic protection, and shall issue an alarm when the cooling water temperature exceeds the high-alarm setpoint.
ER-R001-03.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R001-04.original_name: 热带海区高温环境适应性
ER-R001-04.original_text: 系统应能在热带海区高温环境下保持稳定冷却能力，具体冷却能力参数应按主机厂家Technical Data确认。
ER-R001-04.english_text: The system shall maintain stable cooling capacity in high-temperature tropical waters. Specific cooling capacity parameters shall be confirmed against the main engine manufacturer's Technical Data.
ER-R001-04.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

R002.original_name: 主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求。高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致。
R002.original_text: 主机入口和出口冷却水温度、压力、流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求。高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致。
R002.english_text: The cooling water temperature, pressure and flow at the main engine inlet and outlet shall meet the requirements of the main engine manufacturer's technical documentation. The design parameters of the high-temperature and low-temperature cooling water circuits shall be consistent with the main engine technical data, pump curves, cooler selection and heat-balance calculations.
R002.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R002-01.original_name: 主机冷却水进出口参数
ER-R002-01.original_text: 主机冷却水系统应设计为在发动机进口处的冷却水温度保持在发动机制造商规定的限值内，且高温淡水回路最高进口温度与恒温器开启温度之差不超过36°C。
ER-R002-01.english_text: The main engine cooling water system shall be designed to maintain the cooling water temperature at the engine inlet within the limits specified by the engine manufacturer. The difference between the maximum inlet temperature of the high-temperature fresh-water circuit and the thermostat opening temperature shall not exceed 36°C.
ER-R002-01.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R002-01-01.original_name: 主机冷却水进出口参数
ER-R002-01-01.original_text: 主机冷却水压力应满足主机厂家技术文件要求，低温冷却水回路压力不应超过2 bar（基于MAN 49/60 Project Guide数据，其他厂家按Technical Data确认）。
ER-R002-01-01.english_text: The main engine cooling water pressure shall meet the requirements of the main engine manufacturer's technical documentation. The pressure in the low-temperature cooling water circuit shall not exceed 2 bar (based on the MAN 49/60 Project Guide; for other manufacturers, confirm against their Technical Data).
ER-R002-01-01.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R002-01-02.original_name: 主机冷却水进出口参数
ER-R002-01-02.original_text: 主机冷却水流量应满足主机厂家技术文件要求，并通过热平衡计算和泵曲线验证。
ER-R002-01-02.english_text: The main engine cooling water flow shall meet the requirements of the main engine manufacturer's technical documentation and shall be verified through heat-balance calculations and pump curves.
ER-R002-01-02.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R002-02.original_name: 高低温回路设计参数一致性
ER-R002-02.original_text: 高温冷却水回路和低温冷却水回路的设计参数应与主机技术数据、泵曲线、冷却器选型和热平衡计算保持一致。
ER-R002-02.english_text: The design parameters of the high-temperature and low-temperature cooling water circuits shall be consistent with the main engine technical data, pump curves, cooler selection and heat-balance calculations.
ER-R002-02.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

R004.original_name: 冷却水系统管路布置应清楚、紧凑并便于施工。管路走向、阀门位置、支架布置、放水点、排气点和设备接口应便于现场焊接、安装、冲洗、压力试验和后续检查。
R004.original_text: 冷却水系统管路布置应清楚、紧凑并便于施工。管路走向、阀门位置、支架布置、放水点、排气点和设备接口应便于现场焊接、安装、冲洗、压力试验和后续检查。
R004.english_text: The cooling water system piping arrangement shall be clear, compact and suitable for construction. Pipe routing, valve locations, support arrangement, drain points, vent points and equipment interfaces shall facilitate on-site welding, installation, flushing, pressure testing and subsequent inspection.
R004.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R004-01.original_text: 冷却水系统管路布置应清楚、紧凑，管路走向应便于现场焊接、安装、冲洗、压力试验和后续检查。
ER-R004-01.english_text: The cooling water system piping arrangement shall be clear and compact. Pipe routing shall facilitate on-site welding, installation, flushing, pressure testing and subsequent inspection.
ER-R004-01.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R004-02.original_text: 阀门位置和支架布置应便于现场操作、安装和后续检查，阀门操作侧应留有足够空间，支架应便于固定和调整。
ER-R004-02.english_text: Valve locations and support arrangements shall facilitate on-site operation, installation and subsequent inspection. Sufficient space shall be provided on the valve operating side, and supports shall allow convenient fastening and adjustment.
ER-R004-02.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R004-03.original_text: 管路应在最低点设置放水点，在最高点设置排气点，以便于系统冲洗和压力试验。
ER-R004-03.english_text: Drain points shall be provided at the lowest points of the piping and vent points at the highest points to facilitate system flushing and pressure testing.
ER-R004-03.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending

ER-R004-04.original_text: 设备接口应便于现场焊接、安装和后续检查，接口周围应留有足够的操作空间，并考虑拆卸和维修的便利性。
ER-R004-04.english_text: Equipment interfaces shall facilitate on-site welding, installation and subsequent inspection. Sufficient working space shall be provided around the interfaces, with consideration given to ease of dismantling and maintenance.
ER-R004-04.translation_status: assistant_translated; numeric/unit/condition checks completed; independent domain review pending
